value.answer: For short stretches, yes. Most adults handle it fine at low doses for a short time. The bigger question is long-term use: a preliminary study presented in November 2025 linked taking it a year or more, in people with chronic insomnia, to higher rates of heart failure. It hasn't been peer-reviewed and can't prove cause, since poor sleep may be the real factor. If you're thinking of using it regularly for a while, or you take other meds, run it by your doctor first.
